title: Lumina-swarm
tagline: AI-powered multi-agent swarm for smarter decentralized crypto trading
description:
LuminaSwarm is a decentralized multi-agent AI system for crypto decision-making. It uses specialized agents that collaborate in real time: a Listener analyzes market sentiment, an Analyst evaluates technical and liquidity signals, and an Executor performs risk-aware trade decisions. Instead of relying on a single model, the swarm coordinates multiple agents to improve reliability and reduce errors.

The system integrates with decentralized exchanges like Uniswap and maintains persistent learning, allowing it to adapt over time. LuminaSwarm enables more intelligent, autonomous, and transparent trading in fast-moving Web3 environments.
how_its_made:
LuminaSwarm is built as a modular multi-agent system where each agent (Listener, Analyst, Executor) runs independently and communicates through a central orchestration layer. The backend is developed using JavaScript/TypeScript, and blockchain interactions are handled with ethers.js.

Smart contract components are written in Solidity and tested using Hardhat. The system integrates with Uniswap for liquidity analysis and trade execution, with wallet connectivity via MetaMask.

Agents exchange signals asynchronously and simulate consensus before execution, improving reliability while keeping the architecture lightweight and scalable.
auto_summary: A React and Express app simulates a multi-agent crypto trading workflow with mocked endpoints for memory, negotiation, and quote retrieval.
